title: Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片
titleEn: Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip
summary: 以量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異解析Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip through quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 依公開研究與裝置資料編寫的離線模型、編譯及證據判讀。不是實機組裝、雷射或低溫作業SOP；假想算例不代表廠商精度、量子優勢或容錯能力。研發宣稱與已驗證觀測分開標示。
scopeEn: Offline models, compilation and evidence interpretation from public research/device sources. Not hardware assembly, laser/cryogenic SOPs; assumed examples are not vendor fidelity, advantage or fault tolerance. Development claims and demonstrated observations remain distinct.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片案例中比較閘定義量子點與鄰點交換，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate gate-defined dots and neighbor exchange within the Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip case.

steps.title: 量子點與自旋子空間：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Quantum dots and spin subspaces: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對閘定義量子點提出可反駁的量子點與自旋子空間模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable quantum dots and spin subspaces model and evidence record for gate-defined dots.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識閘定義量子點。閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。 建立量子點與自旋子空間的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify gate-defined dots in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip. Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of quantum dots and spin subspaces, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。
steps.observationEn: Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：能看到量子點就已證明自旋閘與讀出。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Observing a quantum dot proves spin gates and readout.
steps.check: 提交閘定義量子點的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gate-defined dots.

knowledge.title: 量子點與自旋子空間
knowledge.text: 閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。 本課架構對應：閘定義量子點
knowledge.textEn: Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position. Course architecture correspondence: Gate-defined dots

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；能看到量子點就已證明自旋閘與讀出。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Observing a quantum dot proves spin gates and readout.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設 57 個獨立且相同錯誤率 p=0.0011 的事件，無錯誤機率 (1−p)^57=0.939193。此簡化不含相干、相關、洩漏與讀出錯誤，不能預測完整量子電路或邏輯精度。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 57 independent events with equal p=0.0011: no-error probability (1−p)^57=0.939193. Coherent, correlated, leakage and readout errors are omitted; this does not predict full-circuit/logical fidelity.

quiz.question: 就閘定義量子點的「量子點與自旋子空間」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for quantum dots and spin subspaces in gate-defined dots?
options: 閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。
能看到量子點就已證明自旋閘與讀出。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position.
Observing a quantum dot proves spin gates and readout.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: 閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。 分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。
quiz.explanationEn: Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position. Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels.

steps.title: 量子點與自旋子空間：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Quantum dots and spin subspaces: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對閘定義量子點提出可反駁的量子點與自旋子空間模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable quantum dots and spin subspaces model and evidence record for gate-defined dots.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「量子點與自旋子空間」模型，檢查閘定義量子點的兩個假想案例。分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分閘定義侷限與電荷狀態；電子自旋提供與電荷位置不同的位元自由度。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous quantum dots and spin subspaces model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving gate-defined dots. Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "Gates define confinement/charge; electron spin supplies a degree of freedom distinct from position." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 分開電荷穩定圖與自旋態能階圖。
steps.observationEn: Separate a charge stability diagram from spin levels.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：能看到量子點就已證明自旋閘與讀出。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Observing a quantum dot proves spin gates and readout.
steps.check: 提交閘定義量子點的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for gate-defined dots.

steps.title: 交換相互作用：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對鄰點交換提出可反駁的交換相互作用模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable exchange interactions model and evidence record for neighbor exchange.
steps.instruction: 在「Intel Tunnel Falls 矽自旋研究晶片」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識鄰點交換。鄰近電子的波函數重疊調節交換；電荷雜訊可能映射為閘誤差。 建立交換相互作用的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是量子點、交換、自旋讀出與晶圓變異。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對假想 J 參數做靈敏度與噪聲傳播。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify neighbor exchange in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Intel Tunnel Falls silicon-spin research chip. Wavefunction overlap controls exchange; charge noise can become gate error. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of exchange interactions, focusing on quantum dots, exchange, spin readout and wafer variability. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Propagate assumed J sensitivity and noise. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 對假想 J 參數做靈敏度與噪聲傳播。
steps.observationEn: Propagate assumed J sensitivity and noise.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：縮小點間距一定改善所有誤差。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Reducing dot spacing improves every error source.
steps.check: 提交鄰點交換的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for neighbor exchange.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for exchange interactions in neighbor exchange?
options: 縮小點間距一定改善所有誤差。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
鄰近電子的波函數重疊調節交換；電荷雜訊可能映射為閘誤差。
optionsEn: Reducing dot spacing improves every error source.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
Wavefunction overlap controls exchange; charge noise can become gate error.
quiz.explanation: 鄰近電子的波函數重疊調節交換；電荷雜訊可能映射為閘誤差。 對假想 J 參數做靈敏度與噪聲傳播。
quiz.explanationEn: Wavefunction overlap controls exchange; charge noise can become gate error. Propagate assumed J sensitivity and noise.

Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
